title: arXiv:2209.07653
quoted_text: I argue that one cannot have a fully objective, external picture of the birth process because the order in which the spacetime atoms are born is a partial order. I propose that live experience in causal set theory is an internal view of the objective birth process in which events that are neural correlates of consciousness occur.

title: arXiv:1803.09107
quoted_text: We show how it can reconcile inconsistent empirical findings on the timing of the neural correlates of consciousness (NCCs) , and make testable predictions. According to this hypothesis, a stimulus is consciously perceived for as long as it is recoded to fit an ongoing stream composed of all other perceived stimuli .
